title: A group's locked list does nothing for a list or string key, so a later layer's extension_paths replaces the code of an extender the group locked
goal: a key a group file lists under locked raises SettingsError naming the key and the group file when a later layer sets it, for list and string keys (extension_paths, gate_checks, group) as for object leaves, so no later layer's extension_paths can shadow a locked extender

run:
import json,os,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbsettings
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=T/"g.json"
for key,val in (("extension_paths",[str(T/"u")]),("gate_checks",[["true"]]),("group","acme")):
    g.write_text(json.dumps({"locked":[key]}))
    os.environ["KB_GROUP_SETTINGS"]=str(g)
    (T/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({key:val}))
    try:
        kbsettings.layer_files(T)
    except kbsettings.SettingsError as e:
        m=str(e)
        assert key in m and "g.json" in m, m
    else:
        sys.exit("not yet: "+key+" is locked and layer_files raised nothing")
